book.title: The House at Pooh Corner (Winnie-the-Pooh, #2)
book.description: This deluxe edition of The House At Pooh Corner is the perfect way to celebrate the enduring popularity of A. A. Milne’s classic work and a stunning companion to the Winnie-the-Pooh 80th Anniversary Edition. The interior features the unabridged text and Ernest H. Shepard’s charming illustrations in full color on cream-colored stock. It is an impressive package for new fans and collectors both. Three cheers for Pooh!
